info.name: Repair Shop — Canonical API Regression
info.description: Run all requests sequentially against an EMPTY dedicated test database. Creates 2 users and 12 notes; tests GET contract and CRUD; cleans up. Optional tie fixture is skipped unless runTieFixture=true. Not a claim of exhaustive testing or a recorded live pass.

item.name: 01 Setup — empty dedicated test database required
Capture note IDs and baseline ordering

exec: const sorted=[...b.notes].sort((a,c)=>Date.parse(c.updatedAt)-Date.parse(a.updatedAt)||c._id.localeCompare(a._id));pm.test('Timestamp and ID descending order',()=>pm.expect(b.notes.map(n=>n._id)).to.eql(sorted.map(n=>n._id)));pm.collectionVariables.set('order',JSON.stringify(sorted.map(n=>n._id)));pm.test('Create default completed false',()=>pm.expect(b.notes.find(n=>n._id===pm.collectionVariables.get('id1')).completed).to.eql(false));

item.name: 02 GET notes — search, completed, blank inputs, literal regex
03 GET notes — pagination, metadata and sorting
05 CRUD regression — unchanged handlers, persistence and guards
Update user active false, preserve password
Verify user update and password exclusion
Update note true to false, own title accepted
Verify note update, false accepted, newest first

exec: pm.test('Update persisted and moves note first',()=>{pm.expect(b.notes[0]._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('id2'));pm.expect(b.notes[0].completed).to.eql(false);pm.expect(b.notes[0].text).to.eql('Updated persistent text');});

item.name: 06 Cleanup — deletes only this run’s fixtures
Deleted note cannot be deleted again
Deleted user cannot be deleted again
07 Optional equal-timestamp fixture — skipped by default

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('Both tie fixtures found',()=>pm.expect(b.notes.length).to.eql(2));pm.test('Equal timestamp and descending ID',()=>{pm.expect(b.notes[0].updatedAt).to.eql(b.notes[1].updatedAt);pm.expect(b.notes[0]._id).to.eql('650000000000000000000002');pm.expect(b.notes[1]._id).to.eql('650000000000000000000001');});
